scripts.build: tsc --noEmit false && node --input-type=module -e "import { copyFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); writeFileSync('dist/service-worker.js', 'import \"./apps/chrome-extension/src/service-worker.js\";')"
scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
